messages.subject: hyperlink in UI go to link
parts:
Hello,

I am working on my first Shiny app.  Based on the documentation and gallery it's pretty much doing exactly what I need.

https://gjkerns.shinyapps.io/QueenOfHearts

There's only one thing:  there is a hyperlink at the bottom of the main panel which I'd like to go to an external location.  I managed to get the hyperlink there, and if I hover on it, the correct URL is shown (and available for right-clicking to open a new tab), but if I click on the link directly nothing happens.  This gives the impression that the link is broken, even though it's not.  Here is the relevant snippet from ui.R:

mainPanel(
  ...
  tags$a(href = "http://gkerns.people.ysu.edu/QueenOfHearts.html", "Here are some mathematical details.")
) 

I tried another way with the HTML() function, which I actually like a little bit better, but I had the same result.  I don't know if my error is because of HTML ignorance or because I am not using the correct Shiny syntax/methods.  I searched on DuckDuckGo for other people with this problem, but didn't find anything relevant immediately.

Would one of you please give me some tips to fix this one tiny thing?

Thank you,
Jay
